title: p a n c r e e p e r
description: Flattens the creeper into a rectangle for extra funni :D
body:
**flattens** all creepers **heads and feet** so they are all in **one rectangle**
(only **model change**!)

**REQUIRES: [[EMF] Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and
[[ETF] Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)**
